relationships.subject: LmNaTx15
relationships.evidence_quote: LmNaTx15 slowed the fast inactivation of Nav1.2, Nav1.3, Nav1.4, Nav1.5, and Nav1.7

relationships.subject: LmNaTx15
relationships.evidence_quote: like site 3 neurotoxins, LmNaTx15 induced pain in mice

key_findings: Scorpion toxin LmNaTx15 slows fast inactivation of several Nav subtypes including Nav1.7 but does not affect Nav1.8, and induces pain in mice.
